name: Fall Of Man The
overview: The Fall of Man, as depicted in Genesis 3, reveals humanity's entrance into sin through disobedience, beginning with the subtle temptation of the serpent and the woman's choice to eat the forbidden fruit despite God's clear command. This act brought immediate spiritual death and estrangement from God, contradicting the serpent's lie that they would not die but instead become like gods. Romans 3:12 affirms the universal consequence of this fall, showing that all have turned away from righteousness and become unprofitable, underscoring mankind's inherent corruption and inability to do good apart from divine intervention.
